messages: Thank you for purchasing your [b]B.I.T device![b] And enrolling in the [b]Cyber security program![b]
I'm [b]Cyber Coni[b]. The head of the program!
You are officially a [b]B.I.T Detective![b]
While the digital world has brought incredible advancements, it has also attracted those who seek to cause trouble and exploit modern technology.
Recently we're seeing waves of stronger Viruses that must be other people's B.I.T.S being used for the wrong purposes.
We don't expect you to handle those larger threats yet, but we need you to help patrol the Web for any viruses you see!
Let's log you in with your B.I.T and help you get accustomed to it!
[HOME]This is the Home Menu.
This is where your B.I.T can rest and recharge its health.
You can fill the Home area with programs to create new battle chips and decorations from the shop to make it more homey.
[BATTLE]Next, the Battle Menu is where you enter the net to bust viruses.
You'll earn money, gain experience, and can complete Agency missions there!
[CHIP]The Chip Menu holds special attacks which can made by programs hatched from eggs you find on the net.
These Chips can really help in a pinch when your B.I.T is on the ropes.
[BIT]And here they are, your partner in crime-busting!
You can drag your B.I.T between the Battle and Home Menus any time you like.
And that should be it!
Get comfortable and I'll send you an email with a little sign-up bonus!
Thank you for your service!
GO BERSERK![TUT_END]
